title: Ridgeline Tool Rental Counting of Missing Accessories
content:
The number of missing accessories charged on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement depends on how many are missing.

**Rule.** How the missing accessories are counted depends on how many are missing: when 4 or more are missing they are charged by the matched pair, that is half the number missing rounded up to a whole accessory; when 2 or 3 are missing, the first one is not charged and the rest are; when a single accessory is missing, it is charged.

The number missing is the count of accessories not returned recorded on the return inspection line of the agreement.

## Count table

| Accessories missing | Counting | Accessories charged |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | charged | 1 |
| 2 | first not charged | 1 |
| 3 | first not charged | 2 |
| 4 | by the matched pair | 2 |
| 5 | by the matched pair, half rounded up | 3 |
| 6 | by the matched pair | 3 |
| 7 | by the matched pair, half rounded up | 4 |

## Hypothetical illustration

Five sanding pads do not come back with a Ridgeline Rental Floor and Surface Care drum sander. Half of 5 is 2.5, rounded up to 3 accessories charged.
